### Comparison of Apple Watch Models

Apple's current lineup features three primary models: **Apple Watch Ultra 4**, **Apple Watch Series 12**, and **Apple Watch SE 3**.

#### 1. Price & Configurations
* **Apple Watch Ultra 4:** Starts at **$799** (includes GPS + Cellular and satellite capabilities as standard).
* **Apple Watch Series 12:** Starts at **$399** (GPS) / **$499** (GPS + Cellular).
* **Apple Watch SE 3:** Starts at **$249** (GPS) / **$299** (GPS + Cellular).

#### 2. Design, Materials & Dimensions
* **Apple Watch Ultra 4:**
  * **Case size:** 49mm (49 × 44 × 12 mm).
  * **Materials:** Grade 5 Titanium in Natural Titanium and Black Titanium finishes.
  * **Weight:** 63.0 g (Natural) / 63.1 g (Black).
  * **Display glass:** Flat sapphire crystal.
* **Apple Watch Series 12:**
  * **Case sizes:** 42mm or 46mm (9.7 mm thin in aluminum/titanium; 9.85 mm in ceramic).
  * **Materials:** Aluminum (Dark Bronze, Light Gold, Black, Space Gray), Titanium (Radiant Gold, Natural), and Ceramic (Pearl White, Night Blue).
  * **Weight:** 31.5 g – 52.9 g depending on size and finish.
  * **Display glass:** Ion-X glass (Ceramic Shield 2) on aluminum; sapphire crystal on titanium and ceramic.
* **Apple Watch SE 3:**
  * **Case sizes:** 40mm or 44mm (10.7 mm depth).
  * **Materials:** Aluminum (Starlight, Midnight).
  * **Weight:** 26.3 g – 33.0 g.
  * **Display glass:** 4x crack-resistant Ion-X glass.

#### 3. Display
* **Ultra 4:** Always-On Retina display with wide-angle OLED (LTPO3), reaching up to **3,000 nits** peak brightness down to 1 nit. Display area is 1,245 sq mm (422 × 514 pixels).
* **Series 12:** Always-On Retina display with wide-angle OLED (LTPO3), up to **2,000 nits** peak brightness down to 1 nit. Display area up to 1,196 sq mm (416 × 496 pixels).
* **SE 3:** Always-On Retina display (LTPO OLED), up to **1,000 nits** brightness down to 2 nits. Display area up to 977 sq mm (368 × 448 pixels).

#### 4. Performance & Processing
* **Ultra 4:** Apple S11 chip (64-bit dual-core processor, 4-core Neural Engine), 64GB storage, 2nd-gen Ultra Wideband (UWB) chip, W3 wireless chip, and Audio Intelligence support.
* **Series 12:** Apple S11 chip (64-bit dual-core processor, 4-core Neural Engine), 64GB storage, 2nd-gen UWB chip, and Audio Intelligence support.
* **SE 3:** Apple S10 chip (64-bit dual-core processor, 4-core Neural Engine), 64GB storage, W3 wireless chip (no UWB chip).

#### 5. Health, Wellness & Sensors
* **Ultra 4 & Series 12:**
  * All-new **Health Sensing System** with second-generation electrical heart sensor (ECG app) and always-on optical heart sensor.
  * **Recovery HRV** (sampled every 5 minutes) and high-frequency background heart rate tracking (every 5 seconds).
  * **Blood Oxygen app**, **Hypertension notifications**, and **Sleep apnea notifications**.
  * **Readiness app** (morning readiness score based on sleep, vitals, and activity).
  * **Vitals app** tracking heart rate, respiratory rate, wrist temperature, sleep duration, and HRV.
  * Temperature sensing with cycle tracking, retrospective ovulation estimates, and perimenopause/menopause support.
* **SE 3:**
  * Second-generation optical heart sensor (high/low heart rate and irregular rhythm notifications).
  * Standard HRV, sleep tracking, sleep apnea notifications, and wrist temperature sensing.
  * *Lacks:* ECG app, Blood Oxygen app, Hypertension notifications, and the Readiness app.

#### 6. Battery Life & Charging
* **Ultra 4:**
  * Up to **50 hours** normal use.
  * Up to **84 hours** in Low Power Mode.
  * Up to **18 hours** outdoor workout tracking and **45 hours** in Max Extended Workout mode.
  * Fast charging: 0–80% in ~45 minutes; 15 minutes provides up to 18 hours of normal use.
* **Series 12:**
  * Up to **24 hours** normal use.
  * Up to **38 hours** in Low Power Mode.
  * Fast charging: 0–80% in ~30 minutes; 15 minutes provides up to 12 hours of normal use.
* **SE 3:**
  * Up to **18 hours** normal use.
  * Up to **32 hours** in Low Power Mode.
  * Fast charging: 0–80% in ~45 minutes; 15 minutes provides up to 8 hours of normal use.

#### 7. Durability & Outdoor Capabilities
* **Ultra 4:**
  * Water resistance to **100 meters** (ISO 22810).
  * Certified for recreational scuba diving to **40 meters** (EN13319 standard) with built-in Depth gauge and water temperature sensor.
  * IP6X dust resistance and tested to **MIL-STD 810H** standards.
  * Expanded altimeter operating range from **–500m to 9,000m**.
  * Operating temperature from –20°C to 55°C (–4°F to 130°F).
* **Series 12:** Water resistant to 50 meters (swimming, snorkeling), depth gauge to 6 meters with water temperature sensor, IP6X dust resistance.
* **SE 3:** Water resistant to 50 meters (swimproof); lacks depth gauge, water temperature sensor, and IP6X certification.

#### 8. Connectivity & Safety
* **Ultra 4:** Precision dual-frequency GPS (L1 + L5), 5G RedCap & LTE cellular standard, **Satellite communications** (Emergency SOS, Messages, and Find My via satellite), an **86-decibel emergency Siren** (audible up to 180m / 600ft), dual speakers, and a three-microphone beamforming array with wind noise mitigation.
* **Series 12:** Precision L1 GPS, 5G/LTE options, Emergency SOS, Crash Detection, Fall Detection, single speaker, and mic with voice isolation.
* **SE 3:** Standard GPS, 5G/LTE options, Emergency SOS, Crash Detection, Fall Detection; no satellite or siren.

---

### In-Depth Look at Apple Watch Ultra 4

Designed as Apple’s rugged sports, adventure, and endurance watch, the **Apple Watch Ultra 4** introduces several key innovations:

1. **Rugged Aerospace-Grade Titanium Build**
   * Crafted from Grade 5 titanium in Natural and Black finishes with an elevated bezel that surrounds the flat sapphire front crystal to guard against edge impacts.
   * Tested against military standard MIL-STD 810H (altitude, temperature shock, extreme heat/cold, freezing rain, and vibration).

2. **Extreme Display**
   * A 49mm display capable of reaching 3,000 nits for legibility under intense direct sunlight, dimming down to 1 nit in darkness.
   * Features specialized watch faces (Modular Ultra, Wayfinder, Orienteering) with an automatic red Night Mode.

3. **Dedicated Physical Hardware**
   * **Customizable Action Button:** High-contrast international orange button for instant access to workout controls, interval lap markings, compass waypoints, precision stopwatch start, flashlight, or dive app launch.
   * **Emergency Siren:** A built-in 86-decibel sound pattern triggered by holding the Action button, audible up to 600 feet (180 meters).
   * **Audio System:** Dual speakers for increased volume during calls and media playback, paired with a 3-microphone beamforming array that suppresses wind noise.

4. **Off-Grid & Satellite Connectivity**
   * **Satellite Communications:** Connect directly to satellites for Emergency SOS, satellite messaging (iMessage and SMS), and location sharing via Find My when outside cellular and Wi-Fi coverage.
   * **Dual-Frequency GPS:** L1 and L5 GPS combined with precision algorithms provide reliable pace, distance, and route maps in dense cities or deep wilderness.
   * **Offline Topographic Maps & Waypoints:** Downloadable maps with elevation profiles, contour lines, and automatic backtrack breadcrumbs.

5. **Diving & Water Sports**
   * Water resistant to 100m, high-speed water sport compatible, and EN13319 certified for scuba diving down to 40 meters.
   * Includes an onboard depth gauge that launches automatically upon submersion, real-time water temperature readouts, and support for third-party dive computer apps.

6. **All-New Health Sensing System & Readiness**
   * Delivers Apple's most accurate heart rate monitoring to date, measuring background heart rates every 5 seconds (60x more frequent than Ultra 3) and Recovery HRV every 5 minutes (24x more frequent).
   * Introduces a daily **Readiness Score** in the Readiness app that calculates physical recovery and energy capacity based on sleep, recent activity, and HRV trends.
   * Clinical-grade health tracking including Hypertension notifications, ECG, Blood Oxygen, and Sleep Apnea detection.

7. **Apple Intelligence & Siri AI**
   * Powered by the S11 chip and watchOS 27, Ultra 4 includes Siri AI for contextual voice assistance, as well as Audio Intelligence tools such as **Live Rewind** (transcribing the last 15 seconds of missed audio) and **Siri Recap** (summarizing spoken conversations into high-level notes).

8. **Endurance Battery**
   * Delivers up to 50 hours of normal daily use, up to 84 hours in Low Power Mode, and up to 45 hours in Max Extended Workout mode—engineered for ultramarathons and multi-day backcountry treks.

The more health insights you have, the more empowered you are to take actions that will optimize how you perform. With in-depth clinical validation and FDA-cleared features, Apple Watch Ultra 4 provides a fuller picture of your health, so you can stay informed.

Wake up to your sleep score. 

Sleep quality is influenced by factors such as sleep duration, bedtime consistency, how often you wake up, and time spent in each sleep stage. Sleep score analyzes these factors every night and provides a classification and a score. A new read on HRV.

Track and understand changes in your cycle.

Follow your heart more frequently.

Measure your blood oxygen. It’s a breathtaking innovation. 

The Health app on iPhone uses data from the sensor in Apple Watch to enable you to take on-demand readings of your blood oxygen as well as background readings, day and night.15

Receive hypertension notifications.

Take an ECG anytime, anywhere. 

Check for signs of an irregular heart rhythm, also known as atrial fibrillation, by using the ECG app to generate a single-lead electrocardiogram. You can share your ECG reading with your healthcare provider.17

Heart this app.

Siri Recap can summarize your chats to refresh your memory. 

Siri Recap transforms your conversations into high-level notes, so you can stay focused and present. Each Siri Recap includes a title, a summary, and key points that you can review in the Siri app on your Apple Watch or iPhone. Designed as Apple’s rugged sports, adventure, and endurance watch, the **Apple Watch Ultra 4** introduces several key innovations:

   * Crafted from Grade 5 titanium in Natural and Black finishes with an elevated bezel that surrounds the flat sapphire front crystal to guard against edge impacts.
   * Tested against military standard MIL-STD 810H (altitude, temperature shock, extreme heat/cold, freezing rain, and vibration).

2. **Extreme Display**
   * A 49mm display capable of reaching 3,000 nits for legibility under intense direct sunlight, dimming down to 1 nit in darkness.
   * Features specialized watch faces (Modular Ultra, Wayfinder, Orienteering) with an automatic red Night Mode.

   * **Customizable Action Button:** High-contrast international orange button for instant access to workout controls, interval lap markings, compass waypoints, precision stopwatch start, flashlight, or dive app launch.
   * **Emergency Siren:** A built-in 86-decibel sound pattern triggered by holding the Action button, audible up to 600 feet (180 meters).
   * **Audio System:** Dual speakers for increased volume during calls and media playback, paired with a 3-microphone beamforming array that suppresses wind noise.

   * **Satellite Communications:** Connect directly to satellites for Emergency SOS, satellite messaging (iMessage and SMS), and location sharing via Find My when outside cellular and Wi-Fi coverage.
   * **Dual-Frequency GPS:** L1 and L5 GPS combined with precision algorithms provide reliable pace, distance, and route maps in dense cities or deep wilderness.
   * **Offline Topographic Maps & Waypoints:** Downloadable maps with elevation profiles, contour lines, and automatic backtrack breadcrumbs.

5. **Diving & Water Sports**
   * Water resistant to 100m, high-speed water sport compatible, and EN13319 certified for scuba diving down to 40 meters.
   * Includes an onboard depth gauge that launches automatically upon submersion, real-time water temperature readouts, and support for third-party dive computer apps.

6. **All-New Health Sensing System & Readiness**
   * Delivers Apple's most accurate heart rate monitoring to date, measuring background heart rates every 5 seconds (60x more frequent than Ultra 3) and Recovery HRV every 5 minutes (24x more frequent).
   * Introduces a daily **Readiness Score** in the Readiness app that calculates physical recovery and energy capacity based on sleep, recent activity, and HRV trends.
   * Clinical-grade health tracking including Hypertension notifications, ECG, Blood Oxygen, and Sleep Apnea detection.

   * Powered by the S11 chip and watchOS 27, Ultra 4 includes Siri AI for contextual voice assistance, as well as Audio Intelligence tools such as **Live Rewind** (transcribing the last 15 seconds of missed audio) and **Siri Recap** (summarizing spoken conversations into high-level notes).

8. **Endurance Battery**
   * Delivers up to 50 hours of normal daily use, up to 84 hours in Low Power Mode, and up to 45 hours in Max Extended Workout mode—engineered for ultramarathons and multi-day backcountry treks.
